Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Zoya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Meenakshi - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Rohan stands in the bedroom. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rohan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Rohan (happily): "One more time!"

[Rohan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Zoya stands in the living room. Rohan and Meenakshi stand near her.]

Meenakshi: "Zoya, look over here."

[Zoya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[Rohan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Rohan (excited): "Careful!"

[Rohan writes in his notebook.]

Rohan (happily): "Exactly right."

[Rohan sits down on a chair.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Meenakshi: "I knew it!"

[Rohan opens the window.]

Meenakshi: "Rohan, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's begin."

[Rohan peeks out from behind the door.]

Rohan: "That's easy."

[Rohan thinks for a moment.]

Rohan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Rohan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rohan milks the cow.]

Rohan: "I really enjoyed today."
